verdict.rationale: A tax agency could plausibly publish plain-language, step-by-step explainers for founders, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes recording HTTP 403 edge denials at the robots.txt and application hosts. Nothing in it shows whether the FTB offers plain-language guidance, so the verdict is none.
